lines.speaker: Blond Man
lines.text: Good evening, señora. I do not believe we have been introduced.

lines.speaker: Doña Victorina
lines.text: Good evening. I am Doña Victorina,

lines.speaker: Doña Victorina
lines.text: and this is my husband, Doctor de Espadaña.

lines.speaker: Doña Victorina
lines.text: We have only just arrived. Please, do not let us interrupt the gathering.

lines.speaker: Blond Man
lines.text: It is a pleasure to meet you both.
